Known issues

Every error we know of, for every setup step. Paste part of yours below. Of these 135, the setup file fixes 67 by itself; for the rest it stops and says what to do. Whatever it is, you can always run the setup file again: it carries on where it stopped.

Not listed?

Paste setup's report to Kevin O’Hara, IT help, or to any AI chat. The report is at %LOCALAPPDATA%\HarborlineLab\setup-error.txt (Mac: ~/Library/Logs/HarborlineLab/setup-error.txt).

Starting the setup file

What you seeWhyWhat happens
The window title starts with Select and the output has stopped
Windows		A click started a text selection, which freezes a classic console window until a key is pressed.Setup fixes this Setup turns this off while it works, and turns it back on only when it is waiting for your answer. If you still see it, press Esc. Source
is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, command not found, right after setup
Both		A terminal only sees programs installed before it opened. Windows you already had open, including VS Code's terminal, can't see the new ones.You do this Close them and open a new one. During setup this is handled for you: it refreshes its own window, and if a step fails right after an install it carries on once in a fresh one. Source
Windows protected your PC
Windows		SmartScreen doesn't know this file.You do this Press More info, then Run anyway. Source
Smart App Control blocked an app
Windows		Smart App Control blocks downloaded .cmd files and has no override.You do this In PowerShell, run Unblock-File on the zip in your Downloads folder, then extract it again. Source
Method invocation is supported only on core types
Windows		A company policy (AppLocker or WDAC) restricts PowerShell. Setup detects this and says so.You do this Whoever manages the computer has to allow the file. Source
ScriptContainedMaliciousContent, blocked by your antivirus
Windows		Antivirus blocked the script.You do this Review it under Windows Security, Protection history. Source
This file is being run from inside the zip
Windows		Windows lets you open a zip like a folder, but the rest of the package isn't really there.You do this Right-click the zip, choose Extract All, and run the file from the extracted folder.
Setup doesn't restart by itself after a reboot, from a folder with brackets in its name
Windows		Windows dropped the quotes around the path, and it only tries once.Setup fixes this Fixed in how setup registers itself. If it still doesn't start, run the file again. Source
Apple could not verify, unidentified developer, appropriate access privileges
Mac		Double-clicking a downloaded file, or a zip tool dropped its run permission.You do this Open Terminal, type bash and a space, drag the file in, press Return. This avoids the check. Source
Operation not permitted
Mac		macOS denied Terminal access to Downloads, Desktop or Documents.You do this System Settings, Privacy & Security, Files & Folders, Terminal: allow it. Or move the folder to your home folder. Source
no such file or directory: bash/, is a directory, cannot execute binary file
Mac		A typing or dragging slip: no space after bash, or the folder or zip was dragged in.You do this Type bash, a space, then drag in SETUP-MAC.command itself.
Started with zsh or sh, or from a Rosetta Terminal
Mac		Parts of the script need bash, and Homebrew refuses Rosetta on Apple Silicon.Setup fixes this Setup restarts itself the right way.
Resource deadlock avoided
Mac		The folder is in iCloud and some files aren't on this Mac yet.You do this Extract the zip outside iCloud, for example in your home folder. Source

Checking for a new version

What you seeWhyWhat happens
No update offered, and setup.log says: Update check skipped
Both		No internet, a captive network, or a proxy or firewall blocks raw.githubusercontent.com. The check waits 10 seconds at most and never stops setup.Setup fixes this Nothing to do: setup carries on with the version you have. To get updates behind a company firewall, ask IT to allow raw.githubusercontent.com, github.com and codeload.github.com, or try another network, then run the file again. Source
The update did not work, so setup is carrying on with version
Both		The download was cut off, blocked or damaged, or the new version was released a moment ago and its files don't match yet. The reason is in setup.log.Setup fixes this Nothing was changed. Run the file again later to try again.
This file is version, but version is already installed
Both		An old zip was run after a newer version had been installed.Setup fixes this Setup never copies old files over new ones. It carries on with the installed copy, so you can delete the old zip.

Settings, ports and files

What you seeWhyWhat happens
Your settings file (.env) and its backup are both gone, but your simulator data is still here
Both		Postgres keeps its first password inside the Docker volume, and that password was only in .env. A new one would not open your data, so setup stops and deletes nothing.You do this Put your old .env back and run the file again to keep your data. To start fresh instead, delete the harborline-lab containers and the harborline-lab_pgdata volume in Docker Desktop, then run the file again. That deletes your simulator data and tracker progress. Source
Your settings file was missing, so setup restored it from its backup
Both		.env was deleted. Setup keeps a copy in its own folder, so your passwords and keys stay the same.Setup fixes this Nothing to do.
required variable POSTGRES_PASSWORD is missing a value
Both		docker compose was run before setup made your passwords and keys. No key ships with the package, so there is no default to fall back on.You do this Run the setup file, or start.bat or start.sh, which make them. They never change a key that is already in .env.
ports are not available, forbidden by its access permissions
Windows		Windows reserved that port for Hyper-V or WinNAT, with nothing listening on it.Setup fixes this Setup tests by binding, and picks a free port. Source
port is already allocated, address already in use, Only one usage of each socket
Both		A local PostgreSQL, IIS or Postgres.app has the port.Setup fixes this Setup moves its own port in .env and never stops your service. Source
no configuration file provided: not found
Both		docker compose was run outside the simulator folder.You do this Change to the simulator folder first.
bad interpreter, $'\r': command not found
Windows		Windows line endings in a script that runs in Linux.Setup fixes this Setup normalises the database scripts when it copies them. Source
Mounts denied, is not shared from the host
Mac		The folder is outside Docker's shared locations.You do this Docker Desktop, Settings, Resources, File sharing: add it. Source

Building the data

What you seeWhyWhat happens
exit code: 137, OOMKilled, terminated by signal 9
Both		It ran out of memory.You do this Close other apps, raise the memory limit (Windows: memory= in .wslconfig; Mac: Docker Desktop settings), or build Medium in the Control Center. Source
could not resize shared memory segment
Both		Postgres needs more shared memory. Unlikely with this setup.You do this Raise shm_size in docker-compose.yml. Source
The app stopped answering for 10 minutes
Both		The app or Docker went away during the build.Setup fixes this Setup stops waiting and reports the app's log. Nothing is wiped and a running build keeps going. Run setup again later.
The app did not answer for 5 minutes
Both		The app is busy or stuck.Setup fixes this Setup never starts a build on silence, so your data is safe. It stops with a report. Wait a few minutes and run it again.
Finished data already exists and a build would wipe it
Both		Something asked for a build while a finished build exists.Setup fixes this The app refuses, and setup never replaces finished data. To rebuild on purpose, use Build on the Control Center, which asks you to type REBUILD.
A data build is running: Build large (seed ...), started ...
Both		This version of setup needs the app restarted, and a build is in progress.Setup fixes this Setup asks first. K keeps the build and leaves the update for later. R stops it, restarts on this version and lets you choose a size.
Permission denied: '/data/landing/edi', The app cannot write to the landing folder
Both		The landing folder was deleted and Docker recreated it owned by root.Setup fixes this The app repairs the folder each time it starts, and setup restarts it for you. A build checks the folder first, so finished data is not wiped. Still stuck: check your antivirus.
The data build is taking far too long, or you picked the wrong size
Both		Build time depends on your computer: Medium is about an hour on a typical laptop, Large about three.You do this Press Cancel build on the Control Center, then run setup again and choose another size. Cancelling leaves incomplete data, which is not counted as built.
The drive is nearly full after a build
Both		Large takes about 30 GB. Docker's disk file does not shrink by itself, but the next build reuses that space.You do this Free some space on the drive, or build a smaller size. Ask Kevin before deleting any Docker files.
